description: This source file defines the 'CustomApiRoutesProvider' interface, which provides method signatures for generating custom API routes for authorized and unauthorized access within a gateway service in an Eclipse Ditto-based project.

classes.name: CustomApiRoutesProvider
classes.description: An interface for providing custom API routes for authorized and unauthorized access.

methods.name: unauthorized

methods.name: authorized
methods.description: Provides a custom route for authorized access, given request headers.
